description.zh: A 附近可见白色门板/柜体、木质地板、前方亮白门洞，右侧有高大黑色柜体；这是门口区域，但未呈现完整走廊。
description.en: Near A, white door panels/cabinets, wood flooring, a bright doorway ahead, and a tall black cabinet on the right are visible; this is a doorway area but does not show the full hallway.

description.zh: 画面为带窗玻璃淋浴间，底部右侧可见木地板，说明镜头朝浴室开口内看；不能据此确认已穿过浴室门。
description.en: The frame shows a glass shower with a window, with wood floor visible at the lower right, indicating the view looks into the bathroom opening; it does not confirm that the bathroom door was crossed.

description.zh: 画面出现黑色衣柜、床和床头柜，最后为黑色衣柜近景；可能是在走廊经过卧室开口时向侧方观察，也可能是已进入卧室，无法由这些帧唯一确定，且未看见餐桌、电视或大开放房间。
description.en: The frames show a black wardrobe, bed, and nightstand, ending with a close view of the black wardrobe; this could be a side view from the hallway through a bedroom opening or could mean the robot entered the bedroom, which these frames cannot uniquely determine, and no dining table, TV, or large open room is seen.

uncertainties.zh: 机器人是否始终留在任务要求的走廊内，还是进入了浴室或卧室，现有采样帧无法确认。
uncertainties.en: Whether the robot remained in the required hallway throughout or entered the bathroom or bedroom cannot be confirmed from the available sampled frames.

uncertainties.zh: B 处黑色衣柜近景对应走廊中的柜体还是卧室内的衣柜，不能唯一对应。
uncertainties.en: Whether the close view of the black wardrobe at B corresponds to a cabinet in the hallway or the wardrobe inside the bedroom cannot be uniquely determined.

uncertainties.zh: 是否已到达走廊尽头的大开放房间、右转并走到电视前，尚无观测依据。
uncertainties.en: There is no observational basis yet for whether the robot reached the large open room at the end of the hallway, turned right, and walked to the TV.
